title: cv-deconvolution: code and data for "Separation of Faradaic and Capacitive Currents in Voltammetry through Semi-Derivative Decomposition"
description: Python implementation of the Semi-Derivative Decomposition (SDD) and Dunn methods for separating faradaic and capacitive currents in linear-sweep voltammetry, together with runnable example scripts that reproduce each figure of the paper on simulated data and the experimental ferri-/ferrocyanide dataset.
